videos.headline: Yale's RedHot & Blue – Don't Get Around Anymore (Live Cover) | Ndani Sessions
videos.description:
Experience the timeless classic "Don't Get Around Anymore" performed by Yale's Red Hot & Blue on Ndani Sessions.

Known for their rich harmonies and captivating stage presence, Yale's Red Hot & Blue deliver a stunning rendition of this jazz standard, bringing fresh energy to a song that has resonated across generations.

Watch, enjoy, and let us know your favourite moment in the comments.
